summary: Iteration 3 tested the new Favorites (Recipe Save) feature end to end. Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_favorites.py (17 tests) covering POST/GET/DELETE /api/favorites, POST /api/favorites/{id}/log, ownership isolation, validation and regression; full suite = 35/35 passed (favorites 17 + existing 18 for streak/trends/photo/meals/goals/summary/suggestions). Frontend: authenticated Dashboard flow via session_token cookie (TEST_fe_user) — bookmark button on every meal card, FavoritesBar appears after save, one-tap re-log adds a meal card instantly (<1s, no AI) and updates rings/summary, repeated logging creates duplicates as designed, remove deletes the chip and persists across reload. No blocking defects found.

minor.issue: No duplicate guard — favoriting the same meal N times creates N identical favorites (chips pile up in FavoritesBar). Intentional? consider unique index on (user_id, source meal/name).
Favorite does not store the origin meal_id, so there is no way to detect 'already saved' and grey out the bookmark icon in the UI.

Response includes extra fields (source, from_favorite_id) not present on AI-created meals — meal shape is now non-uniform across creation paths. Harmless today but add them (default None/'ai') to the text/photo paths for consistency.

ui_bugs.issue: Left calorie YAxis has width={40}, which clips 4-digit tick labels: ticks render as '800/100/400/700/0' instead of '2800/2100/1400/700/0' — misleading axis. Increase width to ~52 or use a compact tickFormatter.
favorite-remove-<id> is opacity-0 until hover/focus (group-hover). Discoverable on desktop only — on touch devices there is no hover state, so removing a favorite is effectively unreachable.
Bookmark button gives no persistent saved state (icon never fills / no disabled state), so users can't tell a meal is already saved and can double-save it.

issues: Recharts console warning 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' still fires on mount despite minWidth/minHeight=0 (noisy, harmless).
FavoritesBar is hidden entirely when there are 0 favorites — no empty-state hint, so the Quick-log feature is invisible/undiscoverable until a user happens to click a bookmark icon.

action_items: Fix WeeklyTrends left YAxis width (4-digit calorie ticks are clipped to 3 digits).
Make favorite-remove affordance visible without hover (touch devices).
Optional: dedupe favorites / reflect saved state on the bookmark icon; store origin meal_id on the favorite.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~603 lines with favorites added inline — split into routers (auth/meals/favorites/insights) before it grows more.

Favorites re-log copies nutrients but not `items` validation — if a legacy favorite lacks `nutrients`, POST /favorites/{id}/log inserts a meal with nutrients={} and MealHistory would crash on m.nutrients.calories (frontend reads it unguarded). Defensively default nutrients to a full Nutrients() model on log.
No index on favorites.user_id (list query + 200 limit sort on created_at string). Add a compound index (user_id, created_at).
conftest._cleanup_user did not delete favorites — fixed in this iteration to avoid TEST_ data leaking into the favorites collection.
seed_data_creation: pytest creates/deletes isolated TEST_user_* users per test (favorites now cleaned up too). UI user TEST_fe_user (Fiona Tester, session_token TEST_fe_session_token_1) retained with its 6 original meals; favorites and the 2 re-logged meals created during UI testing were deleted (db.favorites.deleteMany({user_id:'TEST_fe_user'}); db.meals.deleteMany({user_id:'TEST_fe_user',source:'favorite'})).
test_credentials: Cookie/Bearer session_token = TEST_fe_session_token_1 (user_id TEST_fe_user); Emergent Google OAuth otherwise, no passwords.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v (pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope). tests/test_favorites.py covers the Favorites feature incl. cross-user 404 isolation, delete-source-meal-then-relog, and summary/trends deltas. For UI, add cookie session_token=TEST_fe_session_token_1 for domain nutrition-analyzer-35.preview.emergentagent.com then goto /dashboard. NOTE: the selector [data-testid^='meal-card-'] matches BOTH the 'Today's meals' and 'Earlier' MealHistory lists (6 baseline cards for TEST_fe_user, 3 of them today) — assert on deltas, not absolute counts. FavoritesBar renders nothing when the user has 0 favorites.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no functional failures. The clipped calorie axis labels are caused by recharts YAxis width={40} in WeeklyTrends.jsx being narrower than the 4-digit tick text (SVG clips the leading digit); pre-existing, unrelated to the favorites feature.
